Enter inventory directly in the tables below. Changes save when you leave a field. General items use a direct physical count. For completely packed class kits, enter Prepared / received and the app calculates remaining stock from sales, faults, and reservations. Current stock is allocated only to the immediately next semester.

General-item inventory

Breadboards and wire kits are individual stock, not packed kits. Enter the number physically on hand; semester planning asks only for the planned quantity.
